description: Data Protection Officer does not operate with sufficient independence or reports to management in a way that creates conflicts of interest. Article 38.3 requires DPOs to perform duties independently without instructions.
applicability: Applicable to all DPO arrangements. DPO must not receive instructions regarding performance of tasks, must report to highest management level, and must not have conflicting duties.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of DPO reporting structure, job description, and potential conflicts of interest in dual roles.
